preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 30, inclusive.
The number of vertices in each tree is between 1 and 100, inclusive.
The vertices are numbered from 1 to N, and each edge connects two vertices.

preconditions.expression: The graph described on the input is a tree
preconditions.description: Each test case describes a tree, a connected acyclic graph with N vertices.

postconditions.expression: The output is a single integer representing the minimum possible unattractiveness of the resulting tree.
postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum possible maximum absolute difference of integers written on the markers in any two vertices which are connected by an edge.
